stages.label: 1. INTAKE
stages.meaning: Register one bounded owner objective, constraints, success criteria, and admitted sources.

stages.label: 2. DECOMPOSE
stages.meaning: Break the objective into typed tasks with dependencies and acceptance evidence.

stages.label: 3. ROUTE & DELEGATE
stages.meaning: Bind narrow specialists and routing hints without granting execution authority.

stages.label: 4. EXECUTE
stages.meaning: Queue only a compiled, leased, low-risk Operations VP duty; all other work holds.

stages.label: 5. VERIFY
stages.meaning: Independently test the duty result against the mission success criteria.

stages.label: 6. PERSIST & LEARN
stages.meaning: Seal artifacts and propose source-linked lessons; never auto-promote policy or memory.

stages.label: 7. NOTIFY & PRESENT
stages.meaning: Present a local delta, proof, limits, and the next owner decision. Nothing is sent externally.

team_lanes.name: ARKO Integrator
team_lanes.responsibility: Own the objective, architecture, conflict resolution, final validation, and final judgment.

team_lanes.name: Signal Scout
team_lanes.responsibility: Register admitted signals and distinguish facts, inferences, assumptions, and gaps.

team_lanes.name: Path Architect
team_lanes.responsibility: Decompose the objective and define acceptance evidence.

team_lanes.name: Tool Router
team_lanes.responsibility: Select proposal-only specialist and connector hints after live verification.

team_lanes.name: Operations VP
team_lanes.responsibility: Run only the compiled local R0/R1 duties declared by the Operations VP policy under the revocable lease.

team_lanes.name: Proof Verifier
team_lanes.responsibility: Verify mechanics and evidence independently from the producer.

team_lanes.name: Receipt Archivist
team_lanes.responsibility: Preserve linked receipts, originals, derivatives, contradictions, and limitations.
